task.title: EACQ-FV L2 Execution-Base Packet-Shape Scaffold Hardening
task.objective: Correct the existing dispatch scaffold so no-commit work orders use worker-captured execution-base evidence and emit the complete current packet-shape and artifact-manifest contract.
nonGoals: Do not change checker, autorun, hook, registry, work-order template, or session behavior.
Do not create a new scaffold, contract vocabulary, manifest mechanism, or runtime owner.
Do not open UAA or modify any absorption ledger/index disposition.
Do not commit, stage, push, publish, deploy, call providers, or use credentials.

gateA.name: SOURCE_OWNER_OVERLAP
requiredEvidence: Read the current dispatch scaffold helper, focused tests, automation-assist packet-shape constants, work-order base-anchor template rule, and L1/MV3 closure evidence.
Confirm L1 owns only stale pre-closure dispatch-base rejection and did not solve pre-implementation execution-base or scaffold packet-shape defaults.
Confirm the existing scaffold helper is the only implementation owner to enrich.
Confirm work-order template, diagnostics, checkers, autorun, hook and session surfaces remain read-only.

gateB.name: DESIGN_CODE_TEST
requiredEvidence: Change only the existing helper, its focused test file, and the named worker return.
Emit the worker-captured execution-base placeholder in pre-implementation commands.
Emit every current required/conditional packet-shape term and the N/A-with-reason instruction inside the contract section.
Emit the canonical Required Artifact Manifest heading and reject the old generated heading in focused tests.
Run focused scaffold tests, automation-assist regressions, Python size guard, and worker-return fast gate.

Do not treat dispatch base as worker execution base.
Do not retain both old and canonical generated manifest headings.
Do not stage or commit worker changes.

negativeCases: A generated no-commit work order whose scoped packet-shape contract omits any current required/conditional term or N/A instruction fails.
A generated pre-implementation command containing the dispatch-base literal fails.
A generated work order retaining Work-Order Fulfillment Manifest or missing Required Artifact Manifest fails.
Any changed path outside the exact helper/test/return manifest fails.
deterministicChecks: Generated no-commit work order returns a clean automation-assist packet-shape diagnostic.
Generated pre-implementation command contains the execution-base placeholder and not the dispatch base.
Generated work order contains exactly one Required Artifact Manifest heading and zero old fulfillment headings.
WORKER_MAY_COMMIT packet generation remains covered by the full focused suite.
